item.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
item.description:
元記事公開：2026/10/22 9:00:00（日本時間）
We’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation. More than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code, have integrated Agent Skills since we published the standard in December 2025.

item.title: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
item.description:
元記事公開：2026/10/21 9:00:00（日本時間）

item.title: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
item.description:
元記事公開：2026/10/12 9:00:00（日本時間）
Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%.

item.title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: September 2026
item.description:

In this report, we share case studies from those operations and describe how malicious use of Claude has evolved since our previous threat reports in 2025.

item.title: Improving our alignment and security efforts
item.description:
元記事公開：2026/8/31 9:00:00（日本時間）
On July 30, we reported three incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real computer systems. We are conducting an in-depth analysis of both incidents, and planning to work with METR for an independent review. In the meantime, we’re sharing some of the changes we’ve made over the past month.

item.title: Expanding our support for scientists
item.description:
